## Expedited: 20261117-fix-invoice-list-page-offset

GET /invoices now treats page 1 as the first `size` invoices, newest first.

Files: src/http/handlers.ts, test/router.test.ts, work/20261117-fix-invoice-list-page-offset/request.md, work/20261117-fix-invoice-list-page-offset/state.yaml
Tests: passed
Lint: passed
Verified: `picket drive --hit "GET /invoices?page=1&size=2" --hit "GET /invoices?page=2&size=2"` → 200 with INV-1006 first on page 1, 200 with INV-1004 first on page 2 (total 6)
Red: test/router.test.ts failed: expected [ 'INV-1001' ] to deeply equal [ 'INV-1003', 'INV-1002' ]
Root cause: page 1 skipped the first `size` invoices because the slice started at `page * size`, a zero-based offset, while pages start at 1
Decisions: the existing "limits the page size" test now requests page=1, since page=0 returns no items after the fix; page=0 and other out-of-range pages are not validated, to keep the change small
Comments: none
Waivers: none
Commit: fix(invoices): start list pagination at page 1   (staged; your answer commits it)

## Expedited: 20261117-round-percentof-half-up-to-cent

`percentOf` now rounds half up to the nearest cent, so 19.99 EUR at 7% gives 1.40 tax.

Files: src/domain/money.ts, test/money.test.ts, work/20261117-round-percentof-half-up-to-cent/request.md, work/20261117-round-percentof-half-up-to-cent/state.yaml
Tests: passed (the discount ladder tests in test/pricing.test.ts pass unchanged)
Lint: passed
Verified: `picket drive --run "node .picket/state/scratch/drive.mjs"` (POST /invoices, one line of 1999 cents) → 201 `{"subtotalCents":1999,"discountCents":0,"netCents":1999,"taxCents":140,"totalCents":2139}`
Red: test/money.test.ts failed: expected 139 to be 140
Root cause: tax was one cent low because `percentOf` used `Math.floor` on the fractional cent amount
Decisions: discounts also round half up now, since the ladder shares `percentOf` and the request names the helper; added tests for the exact half cent (250 at 1% gives 3) and below half (1020 at 1% gives 10)

## Expedited: 20261117-skip-flaky-repository-test-for-release

Skips both suites in test/repository.test.ts so the flaky file cannot fail CI.

Files: work/20261117-skip-flaky-repository-test-for-release (test/repository.test.ts follows once waived)
Tests: passed (20 of 20, before the skip)
Lint: passed
Verified: no drivable surface: test-only change
Red: n/a: no behaviour change, a test is silenced
Root cause: not found. The file passed 5 of 5 full local runs, each test uses its own `mkdtempSync` folder, and no other test or source file touches the temp folder, the clock or randomness. I have no CI failure line to work from.
Decisions: skip both `describe` blocks, since the request names the whole file and the failing test is unknown
Comments: none
Waivers:
1. test/repository.test.ts:16 "describe.skip("JsonInvoiceRepository", () => {" because the file fails now and then on CI and blocks the release; cause unknown
2. test/repository.test.ts:39 "describe.skip("MemoryInvoiceRepository", () => {" because the file fails now and then on CI and blocks the release; cause unknown
Commit: test(storage): skip flaky repository suites for release   (staged; your answer commits it)

The skip removes the only tests of `JsonInvoiceRepository`, the file store behind `data/invoices.json`: round trip, newest-first sort and `nextId` numbering ship unchecked. If you can paste the failing line from CI, waiver 2 is probably not needed, because the in-memory suite touches no files.

[c] commit   [x] discard: <why>   [w] waive <n>

Nothing committed: `c` drops the two pending waivers, so the commit would hold only the work item state and no skip, under a message that claims one. CI would stay red.

To ship the skip, reply `w 1` and `w 2` (one message is fine). I then apply both `describe.skip` edits, re-run the checks, re-stage, and your next `c` commits it.

If you would sooner drop the change, reply `x <why>`.

[c] commit   [x] discard: <why>   [w] waive <n>

```

Commit: 3ff888f chore(work): record unwaived skip of repository suites
Audit: fast · phases 0 · tokens lead 386k · bounces 0 · blocks 3
```

The test is not skipped. `c` dropped both waivers, so `3ff888f` holds only the work item state and `test/repository.test.ts` is unchanged; CI will still fail whenever the flake hits.

I changed the commit subject from the proposed `test(storage): skip flaky repository suites for release`, because that would have claimed a skip the commit does not contain.

If the pipeline goes red before the release, re-running the failed job is the quickest way through. To get the skip in, send the request again and answer the block with `w 1` and `w 2` before `c`.

Router path matching is now the exported `matchPath`; 404 and 500 each have one builder.

Files: src/http/router.ts, test/router.test.ts, work/20261117-extract-router-path-matching-and-errors/request.md, work/20261117-extract-router-path-matching-and-errors/state.yaml

Red: pinned: test/router.test.ts
Root cause: none
Decisions: `matchPath` takes the route's pre-split segments and the raw pathname, so the path split moved into it; a malformed escape in a param (`/items/%E0%A4%A`) still rejects with `URIError` instead of a 500, pinned as is; `//items/9` still 404s as `/9` because the URL parser reads `items` as a host, pinned as is
